crossRefs.note: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will…
You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and Yahweh brought back the…
that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be…
Behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be…
He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

translations.web: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
translations.bsb: yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.
translations.kjv: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
translations.asv: But one passed by, and, lo, he was not: Yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
